attributes.name: Khorramzadeh Reborn
attributes.powers:
Khorramzadeh Reborn may not be evaded and is immune to the Cold, Fire, Mental, Electricity, and Poison traits.

Before attempting a check against Khorramzadeh Reborn, expend a mythic charge.

If undefeated, discard the top 1d6 cards of your deck, then reset your hand.
